STRIX_API_KEY.description: Strix Cloud PAT prefixed 'strix_pat_'. Minted at https://app.strix.ai/settings -> API keys. Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Normally pre-configured on the dispatcher as a varenv — leave blank in the Run form to use the agent-side value.

STRIX_API_URL.description: Strix Cloud API base URL. Default 'https://app.strix.ai'. Only override for a dedicated / on-prem tenant.

STRIX_MODE.description: Comma-separated list of what to import. Default 'scans,domains,repositories'. Valid: scans (per-scan validated vulnerabilities become Faraday vulns), domains (attack-surface domains -> hosts), repositories (monitored repos -> hosts).

STRIX_SCAN_ID.description: Restrict scans mode to a single scan id. Omit to walk /api/v1/scans and pull the last STRIX_MAX_SCANS.

STRIX_MAX_SCANS.description: Hard cap on how many scans to iterate when walking /api/v1/scans. Default 20.

STRIX_MAX_PAGES.description: Hard cap on pages walked per list endpoint. Default 20.

STRIX_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Client-side severity floor for findings. Valid: info | low | medium | high | critical. Default 'medium'.

STRIX_STATUS.description: Vuln status filter. Default 'open'. Set to 'all' to include closed / snoozed / triaged vulns.

name: strix
title: Strix.ai
description: Strix.ai Cloud REST client (NOT the local strix-agent CLI). Bearer PAT (strix_pat_...) against https://app.strix.ai/api/v1/. Modes: scans (per-scan validated vulnerabilities become Faraday vulns tagged '[AGENT]' with title carrying the endpoint or file, and CVSS + endpoint + method + impact + PoC description + evidence folded into the description, PoC script + code_before + code_after stashed in `data`, remediation_steps + code_diff in `resolution`, CWE/CVE + deep-links to https://app.strix.ai/scans/<sid>/vulnerabilities/<vid> as refs, scan summary emitted as info-level record with executive_summary + report_url); domains (Strix-monitored attack-surface domains -> Faraday hosts tagged 'agent:strix:domain-inventory' with app.strix.ai/domains/<id> deep link); repositories (monitored repos -> Faraday hosts tagged 'agent:strix:repo-inventory'). Vulns are bucketed under the right Faraday host by inspecting each vuln's target/endpoint/code_file. STRIX_MIN_SEVERITY floor + STRIX_STATUS filter default to 'medium' + 'open'. External IDs are stable so re-runs are idempotent. Offset-based pagination; backs off 30s on HTTP 429.
